explication: SwiftVLC is a Swift 6 wrapper around libVLC for Apple platforms. An embedding app creates a Player, supplies media, and presents it through VideoView; the player exposes observable playback state and controls, while distinct APIs cover media parsing, playlists, rendering options, discovery, and Picture-in-Picture. The README and source index establish the major API capabilities and some dependencies; many implementation paths were not sampled, so the graph avoids inferring internal call chains. Showcase configuration is included as a supporting branch, not as the library’s main runtime.
